_about: Public-domain Jacob Duché, rector of Christ Church and St Peter's, Philadelphia, chaplain to the Continental Congress, and later chaplain of the Asylum for Female Orphans in Lambeth, for the Word Hoard: The Life and Death of the Righteous, Human Life a Pilgrimage, The Duty of Standing Fast in our Spiritual and Temporal Liberties, his Discourses on Various Subjects, a London sermon of 1781, and his letter to General Washington. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 128 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
